title: Import
desc: Import a site archive and database dump taken from another panel (cPanel, Plesk, CloudPanel, DirectAdmin…) into this domain.

files.title: 1 · Site files
files.desc: Upload a zip, tar, tar.gz/tgz, tar.bz2, tar.xz or rar archive. Its contents are analyzed before anything is extracted.
files.strip_root: Skip the "{{kok}}" folder and extract its contents directly
files.strip_root_na: No single containing folder in the archive — cannot be skipped
files.wipe_first: Delete existing contents of the target folder first
files.confirm_wipe: ALL existing content in {{hedef}} will be deleted. Continue?

db.title: 2 · Database
db.desc: Upload a .sql or .sql.gz dump. The dump is applied using the target database's own user.
db.no_db: This domain has no database. Create one from the Databases page first.
db.wipe_first: Drop all tables in the target database before importing
db.confirm_wipe: ALL tables in {{db}} will be dropped. Continue?

config.title: 3 · Connection settings
config.desc: Updates the imported application's database credentials with this server's new values (WordPress wp-config.php, Laravel .env). Run this step to avoid a "database connection error" after import.
config.apply: Update config files under {{dizin}} with {{db}} credentials
config.none_found: No updatable configuration file found in the target folder.
